name: Pharadorn Boonruam

title: Full Stack Engineer
summary: Full-stack development and support engineer with nearly five years of experience across applications, front-end and back-end systems, and product support. Interested in system design, architecture, development, maintenance, and troubleshooting to deliver high-quality, high-performance products to the organization.

points.text: Co-developed systems for medical devices, including an overview and operations portal (PWA), a desktop application for claims and reimbursement with government agencies, and integrations with third-party devices. Supported multi-tenant operations on a microservice architecture using ASP.NET Core Web API, Ionic Angular, Telerik, and Raspberry Pi.
Designed, architected, and developed a maintenance support system for medical equipment technicians using Go and React, reducing reliance on Excel records.

Provided technical support and resolved product issues for customers, both on-site and remotely, with positive customer feedback. Contributed to automation solutions, including a chatbot, system manuals, and email and group notification systems.
IT support at an army camp hospital: restructured the annual health check-up booking system and supported hospital staff.

Co-developed and supported an IVR Portal using ASP.NET Web Forms, SAP Crystal Reports, stored procedures, and batch scripts, including error capture categorization and debugging. Also developed report previews and a B2B Portal using ASP.NET C# and Vue.

Architected and developed an Automation Cloud Provisioning Portal based on Ansible and Terraform using Angular, MUI, and Bootstrap, reducing manual YAML preparation and human error from two days to only a few clicks.
bold: from two days to only a few clicks

points.text: Developed a web-based game using Angular and PrimeNG, and enhanced the IAM user access management system using React.

projects.label: Senior Project
projects.text: ITSC Web App, a service that screens and compiles skills and competencies from CVs to assist companies in selecting job applicants. Developed with React, MUI, and Bootstrap on Docker containers.

projects.text: Travel Plan (PHP web application, Android application in Java, and cross-platform application in React Native with Firebase), Thai Rice Web 3.0 (Semantic Web, SPARQL), and Korat LRT (Java desktop application). Deployed projects with Docker on Azure App Service.

projects.label: Personal Project
projects.text: Developed an ERP platform integrated with Odoo that supports multi-tenant provisioning and customizable modules based on user requirements.
